name: @yld-cx/ethereum-protocol
description: yld.cx — Ethereum / EVM L2s Yield Orders Protocol

scripts.build:production: hardhat build --build-profile production && npm run abi:export
scripts.test:fork:ethereum: hardhat --build-profile production --network ethereumFork test nodejs integration/CreateXFork.ts
scripts.test:fork:base: hardhat --build-profile production --network baseFork test nodejs integration/CreateXFork.ts
scripts.test:fork:robinhood: hardhat --build-profile production --network robinhoodFork test nodejs integration/CreateXFork.ts
scripts.deploy:ethereum: YLD_NETWORK=ethereum hardhat --build-profile production --network ethereum run scripts/deploy.ts
scripts.deploy:base: YLD_NETWORK=base hardhat --build-profile production --network base run scripts/deploy.ts
scripts.deploy:robinhood: YLD_NETWORK=robinhood hardhat --build-profile production --network robinhood run scripts/deploy.ts
scripts.verify:ethereum: YLD_NETWORK=ethereum hardhat --build-profile production --network ethereum run scripts/verify.ts
scripts.verify:base: YLD_NETWORK=base hardhat --build-profile production --network base run scripts/verify.ts
scripts.verify:robinhood: YLD_NETWORK=robinhood hardhat --build-profile production --network robinhood run scripts/verify.ts
